title: Wong Sun v. United States (1963)
citation: Wong Sun v. United States, 371 U.S. 471 (1963)
key_points: Holding: Evidence derived from an illegal search or arrest ('fruit of the poisonous tree') is excluded unless an exception applies.
officer_notes: Scenario: An unlawful arrest leads to a statement that leads to drugs at another location.
Takeaway: Legal errors early in a case spread to everything that follows.
